shapes.name: runtime_safety_off_and_977_reduction
shapes.reason: fe_mul median stayed 14 ns. ReleaseSafe fe_mul is 604 bytes with 24 mul and 22 umulh and no library call; the reduction is three widening multiplies by 0x1000003d1, not a loop. @setRuntimeSafety(false) left that object the same size, because the widening product cannot overflow. A straight-line multiply by 977 plus a 32-bit shift was correct against the division test and was 372 bytes with 16 mul and 16 umulh in isolation, but in the node bench fe_inv moved 740 to 1253 ns, point_double 89 to 112 ns, and ecdsa_verify 37202 to 40910 ns. Reverted.

shapes.name: glv_endomorphism
shapes.reason: Both scalars are already split. The package test derives beta and lambda as cube roots, checks lambda^3 = 1 mod n, beta^3 = 1 mod p, and beta*G = lambda*G, and checks the reduced basis. The joint chain has four terms. ECDSA doublings are 127. A second endomorphism pass would not shorten that chain.

residual: fe_mul is 14 ns and 1950 operations, 96 percent of the October 4 ECDSA verify and still the gap after shapes 0-3. The widening u256 multiply is already 24 mul and 22 umulh with no library call. Safety-off and a 977-and-shift reduction left the median at 14 ns and slowed verify, so they were reverted. The count is already the four-term GLV joint schedule: width-16 G, width-4 P, 127 doublings. Window 5 moved the ECDSA count by 1.9 percent and was reverted. The uncommitted lazy 5x52 measured 72 ns. The committed 5x52 kernel in Project/scripts/zig_crypto_open/field52.zig returns Field(1) from mul, so every product runs the carry and the 2^256 fold before the next addition, and the value is a five-limb struct passed by value. That is a reduction on every operation plus a memory round trip. A lazy field only beats the register u256 multiply if the five limbs stay unnormalized across double and mixed and are normalized at compares. That representation was not retried.
binary_note: source_commit pins the arithmetic tree at 041621d. The measured binary also contains the native-store compile gate in Nodes/Zig/src/main.zig.
